title: UAAP: UST cools off FEU with Dwyane Wade at courtside

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—University of Santo Tomas returned to its winning ways in the UAAP Season 89 men’s basketball tournament after stopping streaking Far Eastern University, 81-69, at Araneta Coliseum on Wednesday. With Dwyane Wade sitting courtside, the Growling Tigers snapped the Tamaraws’ four-game winning streak to climb to 3-2 following a heartbreaking overtime loss to National University four days ago. “You all know what happened in the NU game. It was a heartbreaker but the good thing is, the guys weren’t affected so much,” UST assistant coach Peter Martin said. “They just responded. Coaches can only do so much but it was […]...
